terms.gloss: a table of accounts: a spreadsheet
terms.comment: Our use: no reference work has a word for a spreadsheet. Lewis & Short: a statistical table, a book of accounts; Suetonius’s word for the survey of the empire’s resources that Augustus drew up. A spreadsheet is such a table on a computer.
The same thing spelled out, on the pattern of lūsus computātrālis (video game).

sources: Lewis & Short: rationarium · Lewis & Short: tabula
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
